features.feature: Fractions (a b/c, d/c, mixed/improper, S<->D toggle, Simp)
Powers, roots and reciprocals (x^2, ^, sqrt, cbrt, x-root, x^-1, x10^x)
Factorials, permutations and combinations (x!, nPr, nCr)
Numeric functions (Abs, Int, Frac, Rnd, Intg, RndFix, GCD, LCM, MOD, Int/, Rmdr)
BCD decimal precision, catastrophic cancellation and 15-digit rounding
Natural 2D MathIO symbolic exact results (pi, sqrt, fractions) & Ans/Variable recall
Direct & inverse trigonometry (sin, cos, tan, sin^-1, cos^-1, tan^-1) in DEG/RAD/GRA
Hyperbolic & inverse hyperbolic functions (sinh, cosh, tanh, asinh, acosh, atanh)
Coordinate conversion Pol(x,y) / Rec(r,theta) and DMS sexagesimal
Logarithms and exponentials (log, ln, 10^x, e^x, logab)
First and second numerical derivatives d/dx, d^2/dx^2
Definite numerical integration (Gauss-Kronrod adaptive, oscillatory & peaked)
Finite summation Sigma(expr, var, start, end) and long series
Numerical function minimum and maximum FMin / FMax
Complex arithmetic, rectangular/polar forms, Abs, Arg, Conjg, ReP, ImP
Matrix creation, arithmetic, Det, Inv, Trn, Identity, Ref, Rref, Hilbert & size limits
Vector arithmetic, DotP, CrossP, Angle, UnitV, Norm
Simultaneous linear equations 2 to 6 unknowns (regular, singular, ill-conditioned)
Polynomial roots degree 2 to 6 (real, complex, repeated roots)
Interactive Solver & SolveN numerical root finding
List editor, arithmetic, SortA/SortD, Seq, Cuml, DeltaList, CSV
Probability distributions PD/CD/Inv (Normal, t, Chi^2, F, Binomial, Poisson, Geo, Hypergeo)
Base-N integer arithmetic and conversions (Dec, Hex, Bin, Oct)
Logical & bitwise operators (And, Or, Xor, Xnor, Not, Neg)
2D Graphing (Y=, r=, Param, X=, inequalities, V-Window, Zoom, Trace, Sketch)
Graph G-Solv (Root, Max, Min, Y-Icpt, Isct, Y-Cal, X-Cal, Integral)
Dynamic Graph animation with parameter variation
Numerical function tables and range stepping
Recursion sequences (a_n, a_{n+1}, a_{n+2}, b_n, c_n, sums, web plots)
Conic sections (parabola, circle, ellipse, hyperbola) & G-Solv focus/vertex
Financial TVM (Simple, Compound, Cash Flow, Amortization, Conv, Margin, Days, Deprec, Bond)
Spreadsheet formulas, cell references, conditional formatting & stats
Casio BASIC interpreter (control flow, loops, I/O, graphics, strings, recursion)
MicroPython v1.9.4 runtime (math, random, casioplot, compute & graphics benchmarks)
Geometry.g3a add-in (constructions, constraints, measurement box, animations)
Picture Plot (PictPlot.g3a: images, Capt/ plots, curve fitting)
3D Graph (3DGraph.g3a: line, plane, sphere, cylinder, cone, z=f(x,y), rotation)
Physium.g3a add-in (Periodic Table & Fundamental Physical Constants)
Prob Sim add-in (Coin, Dice, Spinner, Marble, Card, Random Numbers)
E-CON4 data logging, sensor config, sampling & graph analysis
eActivity interactive documents, math/graph strips, NOR Flash save/load
Memory Manager (Main Mem, SMEM NOR Flash files, folders, backup, optimize)
System Manager (Display, Power, Battery ADC, Language, Version, Reset)
Data Communication Link (USB Mass Storage / Protocol 7.00 / 3-pin SCIF0)
Examination Mode entry, restrictions and exit/recovery
Firmware Command Catalog & Appendix Error/Range handling
Setup screen modes (Input/Output, Angle, Display Fix/Sci/Norm/Eng, Complex, Frac) & 50-key map
